lesson.menu_desc: What is happening while we speak -- present continuous -- 26 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 4 -- Right Now
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Catarina | Lesson 4 -- Right Now

listenings.text: Hey, sorry, I am recording this on the bus, so it is loud. I am going to my grandmother's house, and I am already regretting it because I forgot my headphones. Anyway. These days I am drawing a lot. I am practising almost every day and I think I am getting better, which is new for me. I am not doing any sport at the moment, and honestly I do not miss it. What are you doing right now? And are you still watching that series, or did you finally finish it?

Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the school fair. I am standing next to the food stand and the queue is getting longer every minute. The cakes are almost finished, so if you are thinking about it, stop thinking and come now. Over on the left, the band is setting up. They are starting in about ten minutes. Everybody is waiting, and nobody is leaving. And, ah. It is starting to rain. So I am going inside. Back to you.

items.situation: Someone messages you: "What are you doing?" Answer with two sentences, not one.
Ask your teacher two questions about her life these days.
tips: What are you getting better at?

items.situation: Tell me one thing you stopped doing, and one thing you only do once in a while.
Something in your week is getting worse. Say what, and why.
Describe what three people in your house are doing right now.
